parsed.reason: Grounded coaching for a 19-month-old: it normalizes two wakings and gives concrete steps for tonight (a boring, consistent check-in, a pause before going in, dropping feed or rock to sleep). The closing plan offer is the expected product shape. One blemish: at roughly 480 characters it runs well past the ~300-character budget, so part of it risks being cut. It also assumes Remy is a 'he'.
